title: Spectral Ribbons
description: Fine lines draw the live music spectrum, bass left and treble right, from two shared end points. Older spectra arc back and fade; attacks leave bright receding lines; raised hands deepen the arc.

parameters.label: Height
parameters.description: How far louder and quieter bands lift and drop each line.

parameters.label: Depth
parameters.description: How far older spectra arc back between the two end points.

parameters.label: Perspective
parameters.description: How strongly older spectra shrink into the distance.

parameters.label: Lines
parameters.description: How many recent spectra are drawn.

parameters.label: Smoothness
parameters.description: Softens the spectrum across frequency and time.

parameters.label: Beat Lines
parameters.description: Brightness of the line left by each attack as it recedes.

parameters.label: Newest Color
parameters.description: Colour of the newest lines and the strongest peaks.

parameters.label: Middle Color
parameters.description: Colour of lines midway through the history.

parameters.label: Background
parameters.description: Colour behind the ribbon. Lines brighten automatically over dark colours.

parameters.label: Body Steering
parameters.description: How much raised hands deepen the arc and move its crest.

provenance.prompt_summary: Layered fine lines drawn from the real audio spectrum, with time running into depth between two shared end points.
